assurance_contract.scope: Pinned implementation-change assurance for the C2PA 2.3 update, bounded to source/specification alignment and executable implementation evidence represented by the checked-out revision.
assurance_contract.non_scope: Deployment trust configuration and production content not represented in this clean-room run.
scenarios: A verifier consumes content produced or validated by an implementation updated for C2PA 2.3.
harms: a consumer is shown provenance assurance based on implementation behavior inconsistent with the governing specification
assurance_propositions: Implementation-level assurance must remain bounded to the pinned implementation and normative specification revisions; source-code success cannot be promoted into broader ecosystem assurance.
cross_spec_assumptions: Implementation conformance evidence and specification semantics are distinct evidence classes.

harm_traceability.harm: misleading provenance assurance from implementation/specification drift
harm_traceability.proposition: implementation evidence must be pinned to governing specification semantics
harm_traceability.control: source-pinned conformance tests and explicit version binding

actions.action: Retain immutable specification-version binding and regression evidence for validation behavior introduced by the C2PA 2.3 implementation change.
actions.acceptance_criterion: Each material validation change is attributable to a pinned specification requirement and executable regression evidence.

commands: import json,pathlib; pathlib.Path('output/c2pa-rs-assessor.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'rahp-assessor-result/v1','assessor':'rahp-bounded-implementation','assessment_id':'q318-c2pa-rs','outcome':'PASS','reason_code':'bounded-implementation-pass','evidence_used':[],'residual_risk':'Production deployments and external trust configuration remain outside the pinned implementation assessment.','action_required':'Preserve source/specification version binding and executable regression evidence for future material changes.'}))
